★ Request
Fade to black
Wah! Really?! Yay~~♪

Passing on the miso soup aside—her dynamic running style was impressive,
and there was something captivating about her mysterious, gentle presence.
Ahaha, I'm so glad~♪

I shouldn't have joined a deserted island tour just to get a change of pace.
I should have at least checked the departure time for the return ferry.

Ehehe... seeing someone enjoy their food so happily really warms my heart~!
I've always wanted someone like that to be my trainer~.

Suddenly, I heard a voice. I had no idea who on earth it belonged to,
but—it sounded warm and gentle.

Hot, hot! Ahaha, starting a fire really is tricky after all~.
—Oh, I found a crab!

That might be true. She really knows how to use her build to her advantage...
There are probably a lot of trainers with their eyes on her.

Regret comes too late. Mourning the brilliant days with an Umamusume
that might have been, I slowly closed my eyes...

Ahaha, you're really chugging it down~.
I'm so glad I brought miso soup~.

Ehehe, I'm so glad I came here today~.
I'll be counting on you from now on, Trainer!

Three days had passed since I was stranded on this deserted island. My meager water and food supplies
had long run out. My phone was still completely out of service.

Oh, I know! You're hungry, aren't you?
Since we're here, let's cook something up!
(Splash...)
(Ooooh~...!)

She helped me sit up and brought a cup to my mouth. A large frame that seemed to embrace everything.
A comforting sense of relief washed over me. Intuitively, I knew. She must be—

...Oh! I know! How about you~?
Would you become my Trainer?!

A piping-hot seafood hot pot packed with fish and kelp broth!
...Just thinking about it is making me hungry~!

Still, that really gave me a surprise~.
Finding an Academy trainer collapsed on the beach and all.

Hishi Akebono just keeps growing, doesn't she?
Isn't she the biggest one at Tracen Academy now?
So, first things first, let's make a fire~☆

I came out here to gather kelp~. I'm good friends with the fishing co-op uncle, you see,
and he told me I could take whatever I wanted~.
That's why I haven't been able to find a Trainer of my own...

If you become my Trainer, let's see...
I'll come over and make you miso soup every single day~!

Whenever I tell the people scouting me that, though,
they just say, "I don't really get it."

I had seen her gentle, heartwarming smile just recently. Right, it was
at the "Event-Based Exhibition Meet," where pre-debut Umamusume primarily compete.

The kelp from around here gives you so much mineral-rich broth,
it's super-duper bono~.
It's a memorable day, so I'm gonna give it my all today~!

The sight of her making a flashy, powerful sprint right across the finish line was unforgettable.
But why on earth was she on a deserted island...?

Swept up in her excitement, I ended up telling her my favorite foods... And just like that,
my three-legged-race journey with Hishi Akebono began out of the blue.
With that thought crossing my mind, I nodded in agreement.

Yup☆ I brought my outdoor cooking gear with me, you see♪
Come to think of it, didn't I have some wild mountain veggies too? Oh, I know. Let's make seafood hot pot~.
In the blink of an eye, she whipped up a delicious-looking seafood hot pot.
Toaaa~~h!

Oh, right! To celebrate today, I'll make Trainer's favorite
food for dinner tonight~! What do you want? What's your favorite~?

I radioed the ferry a little while ago, so everything's totally fine now~.
Let's head back to the Academy together☆

After gulping down the water, a warm cup of miso soup was offered to me. As I eagerly
sipped it, my hazy consciousness began to clear—

Phew~ Smells so good~!
Makes you wanna toss in some udon at the end, doesn't it?!

Taking first place is Hishi Akebono!
Crossing the finish line comfortably by a wide margin!
Having caught a large fish before I even noticed, she cleaned and prepared it in no time—

I don't really know what happened, but it sounds like you've been through a lot~. You're safe now~.
Here, have some water☆
Looking closely, the "goddess" turned out to be Hishi Akebono.
Here you go☆ It's bound to be super bono~.

All Umamusume are loaded into the gates.
Event-Based Exhibition Meet Turf 1200m—and they're off!
Hah, hah, hah!

I have an announcement for everyone.
Actually, this morning—my height finally surpassed 180cm~!

I wolfed it down and swallowed eagerly. When I casually looked up,
my eyes met Hishi Akebono's as she watched over me with a blissful expression.
Bono?
With practiced ease, Hishi Akebono set up the cooking utensils and started a fire—
